item.title: The skincare scheme that led to consumer complaints, lawsuits and a federal investigation
item.description: Free samples, high-pressure pitches and $50,000 bills: An NPR investigation reveals how a network of mall skincare stores systematically targeted older adults and people with disabilities across the U.S..
item.content:encoded: Free samples, high-pressure pitches and $50,000 bills: An NPR investigation reveals how a network of mall skincare stores systematically targeted older adults and people with disabilities across the U.S..

item.title: The skincare sample is free. What happens next can cost thousands
item.description: For years, customers have complained of aggressive sales tactics and charges at mall skincare stores. NPR investigated the business that connects many of them.
item.content:encoded: For years, customers have complained of aggressive sales tactics and charges at mall skincare stores. NPR investigated the business that connects many of them.

item.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico prevail against White House — for now
item.description: A federal judge ruled late Tuesday that President Trump cannot ban news organizations from covering him at the White House because he does not like the nature of their coverage - at least, not until the matter goes to a formal trial.
item.content:encoded:
A federal judge ruled late Tuesday that President Trump cannot ban news organizations from covering him at the White House because he does not like the nature of their coverage - at least, not until the matter goes to a formal trial.

item.title: What ice cream has to do with this year's Nobel Prize in economics
item.description: Prices can get sticky. That helps explain why recessions hurt so much — and what policymakers can do about them.

item.title: Farmers say they'll take the relief of Trump's EO — but they're still hurting
item.description: President Trump says his Monday executive order temporarily suspending federal taxes on diesel will be a big relief for farmers. Some farmers call it a campaign ploy with marginal impact.

item.title: 2 Americans win Nobel Prize in economics for work on boom-bust cycles
item.description: Two Americans have won the Nobel Prize in economics for their work on how to smooth boom-and-bust cycles to limit unemployment and inflation.

item.description: NPR's Joel Rose speaks with Lindsay Owens, president of the economic think tank Groundwork Collaborative, about how companies using data to transform the products and prices customers see.

item.title: It's taking longer to find a new job after losing one
item.description: People who lose their jobs in this economy are taking longer to find new work. Nearly four in ten people exhaust their unemployment benefits before they land a new job.
